summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub release archive into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a rotated numeric/string constant array (`n7gIxM`) and a rotator function (`WV8StW`) with mangled identifiers. The obfuscated payload is not referenced by the library's own `dist/index.js` entry and is executed only through the freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. The package's advertised purpose is a React marketing-email component library (peer deps include react, mobx, @servicetitan/design-system) with no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque install-time bundle. `package.json` also carries an empty `description`, consistent with a compromised publish. The pattern matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: install-time execution of attacker-supplied, statically unreviewable code on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
